$comment: The modules of '@theia/core' that the frontend 'index.js' emitted by the 'FrontendGenerator' of
'@theia/application-manager' loads before it runs the 'Preloader', and which are therefore part of the
preload phase without being declared as an entry point in any package.json.
A module that the generator starts requiring ahead of the 'await preload(container)' which ends the
phase belongs here as well; 'preload-phase-modules.spec.js' runs the generator and fails when the two
drift apart. The remaining requires of that part of the emitted code, 'reflect-metadata' and the shared
'inversify' re-export, are left out because they carry no Theia code.
